icon-layout.description:
Positions the decorative icon relative to its tab label. When omitted,
primary stacks the icon above the label and secondary puts it inline.

label.description:
Accessible name for the tablist. Always provide one when multiple tab
groups may appear in a view. When NOT to use: do not use `label` as a
visible heading; render visible context in surrounding content.

size.description:
Token-backed strip size: every `ki-tab` it holds is 24, 32, 40, 48 or
56px tall in onmars, with its text, and the gap between tabs follows.
The strip decides for all its tabs; a tab has no size of its own. An
unrecognized value matches no style rule and keeps the medium metrics.
When to use: match the size of the controls around the strip.
When NOT to use: do not pick a smaller size to fit a dense region or a
larger one for touch; declare `data-ki-density` on the region instead,
which composes with every size.

variant.description:
Visual treatment for the group. Use one primary group per screen and
secondary groups within content.

--ki-tab-icon-stacked-gap.description: Gap from a stacked tab icon to its label.

--ki-tab-icon-stacked-min-block-size.description: Minimum block size for a tab with a stacked icon.

--ki-tab-lg-font-size.description: dimension used by the tab component for lg font size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 lg: UI/body-2).

--ki-tab-lg-line-height.description: dimension used by the tab component for lg line height (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 lg: UI/body-2).

--ki-tab-lg-min-block-size.description: dimension used by the tab component for lg min block size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 lg: 48px).

--ki-tab-padding-block-end.description: dimension used by the tab component for padding block end (MarsUI Tab_nav_item: 8px inset keeping the 2px underline clear of the 13/24 label; formalizes the fallback ki-tab.css already consumes).

--ki-tab-primary-indicator-height.description: Height of the content-width indicator on a primary icon tab.

--ki-tab-secondary-indicator-height.description: Height of the full-width indicator on a secondary tab.

--ki-tab-sm-font-size.description: dimension used by the tab component for sm font size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 sm: UI/para).

--ki-tab-sm-line-height.description: dimension used by the tab component for sm line height (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 sm: UI/para).

--ki-tab-sm-min-block-size.description: dimension used by the tab component for sm min block size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 sm: 32px).

--ki-tab-xl-font-size.description: dimension used by the tab component for xl font size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 xl: UI/title-2).

--ki-tab-xl-line-height.description: dimension used by the tab component for xl line height (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 xl: UI/title-2).

--ki-tab-xl-min-block-size.description: dimension used by the tab component for xl min block size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 xl: 56px).

--ki-tab-xs-font-size.description: dimension used by the tab component for xs font size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 xs: UI/caption-2). Figma draws caption_1, 10px; caption_2, 12px, is the smallest text the library ships (spec 050 D7).

--ki-tab-xs-line-height.description: dimension used by the tab component for xs line height (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 xs: UI/caption-2).

--ki-tab-xs-min-block-size.description: dimension used by the tab component for xs min block size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 xs: 24px).

--ki-tabs-divider-color.description: color used by the tabs component for divider color.

--ki-tabs-divider-width.description: dimension used by the tabs component for the tablist divider width (the Tab_nav bar has no stroke; the hook stays for consumers to opt back in — material3 keeps its hairline via its override).

--ki-tabs-gap.description: dimension used by the tabs component for gap (MarsUI md bar item gap Space/8xl 26px; the gap carries all spacing now that items have zero inline padding).

--ki-tabs-lg-gap.description: dimension used by the tabs component for the lg gap between tabs (Tab-nav 10048:1249 lg binds Space/9xl, 28px).

--ki-tabs-secondary-selected-rest-bg.description: Selected secondary tab background at rest.

--ki-tabs-secondary-selected-rest-fg.description: Selected secondary tab label foreground at rest.

--ki-tabs-secondary-unselected-rest-fg.description: Secondary tab label foreground at rest.

--ki-tabs-sm-gap.description: dimension used by the tabs component for the sm gap between tabs (Tab-nav 10048:1249 sm binds Space/7xl, 24px).

--ki-tabs-xl-gap.description: dimension used by the tabs component for the xl gap between tabs (Tab-nav 10048:1249 xl binds Space/10xl, 32px).

--ki-tabs-xs-gap.description: dimension used by the tabs component for the xs gap between tabs (Tab-nav 10048:1249 xs binds Space/5xl, 20px).

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

component.description: A tab group for switching between peer content views.

ki-change.description:
Fired once after a user-driven selection change from pointer or keyboard
navigation. `detail.value` is the resolved selected value and `value` is
already current when listeners run. Programmatic `value` writes and
first-render fallback are silent.

tablist.description: Internal row around the tab strip: gap, alignment and the divider. The strip inside it carries the `tablist` role.

slots.description:
`ki-tab` and `ki-tab-panel` children. Tabs are auto-assigned to an
internal named slot as managed output.
